perspectives.mathematics: Exact mass equality uses finite PMF mass sum and ofReal_toReal with finite PMF masses. Expectations and probabilities are identical; both conditional quotients use same numerator/denominator including null-event zero division.
perspectives.model_quantifiers: Conditional argument order is explicitly reversed from Compat event-first to PMF event-last. Factorization uses default only on unrealized histories and assumes exactly fiber constancy. Shifted transfer preserves actual PMF, fine/coarse histories, positive coarse fiber, nonnegative bound, natural Y with integer shift, and fine atom positivity.
perspectives.adversarial: Reviewed null fine fibers, arbitrary unrealized history values, negative target j with no natural preimage, nonmeasurable S, and S excluding fine bad-history values. Reused theorem handles all via monotonicity and coarse finite total probability; S is never inserted into conditioning.

reuse_checked: Read Compat.Conditioning.shifted_anticoncentration_transfer and its coarse_total_probability_bound proof. This adapter invokes that exact theorem without stronger or circular assumptions.
limitations: Independent source/math/model review; U00 supplies compiler and transitive axiom evidence.
